_doc: Balance bands (docs/CONTENT_PLAN.md section 3): the expected stats of a part by family and tier, for the Standard line. bands: family -> tier -> stat -> value. A stat is `power`, `hp` or a key of the part's `stats`. A line multiplies a band the way scripts/sim/stats.gd resolves a part's numbers (a Scrap engine's thrust band is the Standard one times the line's `output`), so a part is compared by its effective numbers. tests/test_content.gd fails a non-unique part of a family listed here when a stat is more than `tolerance` (a fraction) off its band, unless the part has a quirk (a non-empty `abilities` or `side_effects`, or a `quirk` text saying why) or is listed in `waivers`. waivers: part id -> why it is off the bands today; a waiver is removed when the part is fixed (the test fails on a waiver that is no longer needed). Content agents fill these tables from the lead's spec; they do not invent numbers. More families (weapons, shields, reactors, O2, the workshop) are added here when each gets its wave.
